create_CheckpointManager: create a CheckpointManager instance with a storage URL to manage model and entity partition checkpoints
write_entity_partition: write an entity partition with embeddings and optimizer state to the checkpoint storage via CheckpointManager.write
read_entity_partition: read an entity partition's embeddings and optimizer state from checkpoint storage via CheckpointManager.read
write_and_read_model: write or read the model state dict and optimizer state via CheckpointManager.write_model and read_model
preserve_checkpoint_snapshot: preserve the current checkpoint version as a symlinked snapshot for a given epoch via CheckpointManager.preserve_current_version
